w10_T4_003095: The Halden label plant runs a single sticker press. The press stamps out 140 stickers for every minute that it is running. One printing cycle keeps the press running for 4 minutes, and the plant completes 9 cycles in a working day. The plant worked 9 days in a row to fill a rush order. The foreman times every cycle in minutes, even though the head office report asks for the figures in hours. The finished order was then divided equally among 3 regional depots, and the depot at Kessel took one of those equal parts. How many stickers went to the Kessel depot?
w10_T4_003096: Tomas collects old buttons in a glass jar. At the start of the month the jar held 223 buttons. His aunt posted him 66 more, he found 5 under the sofa, a swap meet added 44, and a family friend gave him 22 for his birthday. He then poured the jar out and split the buttons into equal halves. He kept half at home and carried the other half to school for the art club. How many buttons were in the lot he carried to school?
w10_T4_003102: On Monday morning the loading yard behind Priya's shop held 201 crates. Before lunch a haulier drove away with 184 of them. In the early afternoon Priya's neighbour Dev borrowed 14 crates for his own delivery, which left Dev holding more crates than Priya had. Later that afternoon 1 crate was found cracked and was burned. In the evening the depot swapped every crate still standing in the yard for 3 stackable crates of a newer design. Overnight each of those stackable crates was itself repacked into 4 shallow crates. How many crates were in Priya's yard once the repacking was finished?
w10_T4_003105: Early on Saturday the bakery display held 190 bread rolls. During the morning rush customers bought 128 of them. At midday the baker Elena carried out 9 more rolls from the back room. Through the afternoon another 46 rolls were sold, and Elena noticed that her co-worker Sam had served more rolls that day than she had. Just before closing that evening Elena set out 10 rolls that had been cooling on a rack. How many rolls were on the display at closing time?
w10_T4_003106: The Fernhill community radio station had 141 minutes of interview tape in its archive. The producer deleted 99 minutes that were too noisy to broadcast, then recorded 27 minutes of fresh material. All of the tape that remained was divided equally into 3 episodes, and the producer took the first of those episodes to work on. She added 38 minutes of music to that episode. The station logbook records every duration in minutes, even though the printed schedule shows hours. The finished episode was broadcast 7 times over the following month. How many minutes of airtime did that one episode account for altogether?
w10_T4_003109: Omar started the week with 234 roof tiles stacked beside his van. He used 135 of them on the first roof and 53 on the second. His workmate Rita then took 43 tiles for a job of her own, which left Rita with more tiles than Omar. Omar traded his whole remaining stack in at the builders yard, receiving 9 replacement tiles for every tile he handed over. He broke 23 of the new tiles while unloading them, and then found 37 more good ones in the back of the van. How many tiles were in Omar's stack at the end?
w10_T4_003113: Hannah runs a seed library out of her garage, storing the packets in 7 identical drawers. Each drawer holds exactly 203 seed packets. A garden club donated 67 more packets to her, and a spring fair added another 75. Her friend Marcus runs a seed library of his own, though he keeps fewer packets than Hannah does. Hannah then made up 7 identical sets for 7 village halls, each set holding as many packets as her whole collection held, and the packets in all of those sets were counted together. She found 74 loose packets in a coat pocket and added them to that count. How many seed packets were counted in total?
w10_T4_003114: On Monday morning the Larkfield chocolate works set out 7 benches, and each bench held 155 empty gift boxes. Every one of those boxes was then filled with 6 chocolates. A packer tipped in 72 extra chocolates from a spare tray. That same Monday, 9 sites in the group, Larkfield among them, each produced a batch exactly like the one just described, and all the batches were pooled into a single count. The delivery van that serves the group has 3 refrigerated shelves. In the afternoon 48611 chocolates from the pool were shipped out to shops, and in the evening quality control pulled 1505 melted ones from what was left. How many chocolates remained in the pool?
w10_T4_003128: Ivan loads 152 bricks onto every pallet that leaves his builders yard. Each lorry carries 6 pallets. On one Thursday 4 lorries left the yard, and the identical run was repeated on 3 separate Thursdays. Ivan's business partner Marta runs a second yard, but she moved fewer bricks than Ivan did. All the bricks from those runs were then split equally between 6 building sites, and the site at Copper Lane received one of those equal shares. How many bricks arrived at Copper Lane?
w10_T4_003135: Nadia began the quiz season with 203 points on her card. She lost 51 points for a missed round, then won 67 in the second heat and another 72 in the third. A penalty in the semi-final cost her 188 points. The scoreboard in the hall can display up to 999 points at once. At the final the organisers converted every point still on her card into 2 credits. She was then handed 63 bonus credits for arriving early. How many credits did Nadia hold at the end?
w10_T4_003138: Theo keeps a training diary for his cycling. He rode for 131 minutes on each of the 5 weekdays of one week. Illness later forced him to cross out 222 of those minutes as unridden. He added a long weekend ride of 78 minutes to the same week's total, and then remembered a warm-up of 3 minutes that he had never written down. His diary is always kept in minutes, even though the club newsletter prints everyone's totals in hours. How many minutes does Theo's diary show for that week?
w10_T4_003139: A nursery started the season with 222 tulip bulbs and sold 185 of them to a garden centre straight away. Every bulb that was left produced 9 offsets during the summer. A neighbour donated 65 more offsets, and 17 others turned up in a forgotten tray. The nursery's main greenhouse has 4 heated benches. In the autumn each offset was divided into 6 plantable pieces, and a hard frost later killed 1006 of those pieces. How many plantable pieces did the nursery still have?
w10_T4_003140: Early on Saturday morning Farmer Odile counted 179 eggs in her store room. Before breakfast her hens laid 13 more. At midday she sold 47 eggs to a village cafe. Her brother Pierre gathers eggs on his own farm, but he collected fewer that day than Odile did. In the afternoon a wholesaler swapped every egg still in Odile's store room for 6 quail eggs. That evening 531 of the quail eggs were packed and driven away. How many quail eggs were left in the store room?
w10_T4_003141: Each morning the Hillcrest depot sends out 8 shuttle buses, and on Monday every one of them pulled away carrying 58 passengers. Later that morning another 33 passengers boarded at the market stop. The depot timetable lists every journey in minutes rather than in hours. That same pattern of boardings was repeated on each of the 5 days of the week. On Friday evening 3 extra passengers were squeezed onto the last shuttle. The depot then ran 3 more identical weeks with exactly those figures, and only those weeks were counted. How many passenger journeys were counted in total?
w10_T4_003145: Early on Friday a cheese stall had 203 wedges ready, and 82 of them were sold before noon. In the afternoon a school order took another 109 wedges away. The stallholder writes her prices in cents on the tickets, though the till receipts are printed in dollars. Just before closing a supplier dropped off 52 fresh wedges, and the chiller behind the stall can hold 300 wedges in all. That evening every wedge still on the stall was cut into 9 tasting slices. How many tasting slices did the stall end up with?
w10_T4_003146: Kofi keeps model aeroplane kits on a shelf, and at the start of the holidays there were 13 of them. He gave 8 of the kits to his cousin, who lives 40 kilometres away. Every kit that stayed on the shelf contained 9 plastic sprues of parts. Kofi snapped 1 sprue while opening a box and mislaid 6 others under his bed. He used up 33 sprues building models over the summer, and a friend later handed him 13 spare sprues. How many sprues did Kofi have at the end of the holidays?
w10_T4_003147: A chamber group prepared a new work that ran to 69 pages of score. The composer discarded 12 of those pages before rehearsals began. Each page that survived takes exactly 5 minutes to play. The director then cut 230 minutes from the piece so that it would fit an evening slot. The stage manager times everything in minutes, although the printed programme gives the running time in hours. The group performed the shortened piece 7 times on tour, and 86 minutes of playing were lost when one concert was stopped early. How many minutes of music did the group actually play on that tour?
w10_T4_003148: An orchard brought in 33 sacks of apples on the first day of picking. 4 of the sacks were spoiled and thrown away. Every sack that was kept was tipped out and repacked into 2 smaller sacks. The packers sold 37 of the smaller sacks at the gate, and each smaller sack still left weighed 4 kilograms. The remaining fruit was divided equally between 3 village shops, and the shop at Ardley took one of those equal shares. That shop already had 78 kilograms of apples in its store room. How many kilograms of apples did the Ardley shop then hold?
w10_T4_003150: Early on Saturday the allotment shed held 32 sacks of compost. During the morning 6 sacks were found split and were discarded, and 25 sacks were lent to a neighbouring allotment. In the afternoon a delivery of 32 fresh sacks arrived. Every sack in the shed holds 8 litres of compost. In the evening the whole store was shared equally between 3 growing beds, and the bed nearest the gate received one of those shares. That bed already contained 65 litres of compost from an earlier delivery. How many litres of compost were in the bed nearest the gate?
w10_T4_003167: Each morning the Verano bakery loads 141 pastries onto every one of its 6 delivery trays. The bakery does this on each of the 5 mornings it opens. During the afternoons of that same week it added 35 pastries from a cancelled order and 53 more brought back from a market stall. The owner keeps a dozen recipe cards pinned above the oven. The van driver logs his rounds in minutes, although the delivery contract is written in hours. Each of the 6 branches in the chain then produced a week exactly like that one, and the whole chain's pastries were counted together. How many pastries were counted in total?
w10_T4_003175: Yusuf stacks 60 tins on each of the 6 shelves in his corner shop. A wholesaler delivered 77 more tins on Tuesday. Customers bought 104 tins that week, and a food bank collection carried away 266 tins. Yusuf's cousin Selim runs a shop two streets over and sold more tins that week than Yusuf did. The shop's front window is 3 metres wide. A further 9 tins were found dented and were taken off the shelves. How many tins did Yusuf's shop have left?
w10_T4_003178: Maya had 65 blank sticker sheets in her craft box, and her brother Theo gave her 36 more. Every sheet carries 8 stickers. Every sticker is printed as a pattern of 8 tiny dots. A dozen of the sheets are printed on gold paper. The class project used up 2937 of the dots, and Theo used fewer dots on his own project than Maya did on hers. How many printed dots did Maya have left?
w10_T4_003183: Ravi bought 164 wooden slats for a school project. He sent back 66 that were warped and passed 25 on to his neighbour Lena, who was left with fewer slats than Ravi still had. Each slat that Ravi kept was sawn into 8 short blocks, and every one of those blocks weighs 5 grams. A dozen of the blocks were painted red for a display. The whole pile was then shared equally between 5 school workshops, and the workshop at Mill Road took one of the shares. How many grams of wood did the Mill Road workshop receive?
w10_T4_003184: On Monday morning the hardware store had 189 boxes of screws in the stockroom. Before lunch 121 of the boxes were sold to a builder. Each box that remained holds 6 packets of screws. In the afternoon the manager Grace removed 22 damaged packets, and in the evening her colleague Ben returned 22 packets he had borrowed, leaving Ben with fewer packets than Grace had on the shelf. A dozen of the packets are labelled for brass screws. Overnight the warehouse replaced every packet in the stockroom with 9 smaller sachets. How many sachets were in the stockroom on Tuesday?
w10_T4_003197: A city library began the year with 231 audio recordings, and a donation added 73 more. The librarian had every recording copied so that each one existed as 2 separate files. Each file was afterwards split into 4 chapter tracks for streaming. The library's reading room seats 120 people. A volunteer then uploaded 79 extra tracks recorded at a local event. The catalogue lists every track length in minutes, even though the annual report gives them in hours. How many tracks did the library's collection contain?
